title: This Time, the Korean Loudspeaker Standoff Is Different
author: Lee Sook-yeon
text:
In this image provided by North Korean state media, Kim Yo Jong visits the border area to inspect fortifications, Oct. 21, 2026.
Credit: KCNA
On October 21, after inspecting fortification work along North Korea’s southern border, Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, announced that “within October, the loudspeakers for psychological warfare against the ROK will be in operation along the whole border.” (ROK refers to the Republic of Korea, South Korea’s formal name.) Two days earlier, Kim Yo Jong had said Pyongyang was considering the step, along with deploying more “tactical strike means” near the border. As a rationale, she cited the behavior of South Korean troops near the border, claiming they had issued 2,870 warning broadcasts and fired warning shots on 201 occasions between August 1 and October 17.[...]
